U_0x000A69: Unit 1 of the R Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-1." Built for close-quarters combat, it has high mobility and attack power. It inherits the strengths of its predecessors, the RTX-009 "Huckebein 009 (plasma generator model)" and PTX-006 "Wildraubtier." Like the latter it transforms into a flight form, the R-Wing, and often serves as the R Series' vanguard for surprise attacks and armed recon. It carries live-ammo weapons for short and medium range to deal reliable damage, and its <T-LINK System> allows attacks applying the Telekinetic Field it generates.
U_0x000EDC: R-1's flight form, used for transit and recon. The nose section is R-1's shield in <Personal Trooper> form.
U_0x000FDE: Unit 2 of the R Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-2 POWERED." A heavy <Personal Trooper> for beam bombardment, carrying the <Tronium> Engine that powers the SRX. Firepower and armor are high, but unstable engine output and poor mobility are weaknesses; within the R Series it handles suppressive fire and artillery support. Plus parts - the Hyzol Launcher, a heavy metal particle cannon, and shoulder armor - make it the R-2 Powered. In the combined SRX, R-2's pilot regulates the engine's output, handles damage control, and monitors the other pilots' condition. Lacking the <T-LINK System>, its pilot need not be a Psychodriver.
U_0x0014C2: Unit 3 of the R Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-3 POWERED." A light command-use, long-range <Personal Trooper> with <T-LINK System>-based remote weapons and superb detection and intel gathering. Only Psychodrivers can pilot it; in practice it is Capt. Aya Kobayashi's machine. Plus parts with a T-LINK Flight System make it the heavy bomber R-3 Powered.
U_0x001802: Unit 1 of the RW Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-GUN." Originally a high-output heavy metal particle cannon, it was miniaturized for a certain purpose and given a <Personal Trooper> transformation so it could fight on its own. Its new <Tronium> Engine exceeds R-2's, with output and firepower above the other R Series, though extremely unstable. Effectively the fourth R Series unit but never named "R-4," it was developed in secret at <Mao Industries> on the Moon under the codename "ARGAN." With plus parts like the back-mounted High Twin Launcher it becomes R-GUN Powered. After the <L5 Campaign>, the improved <T-LINK System> enabled T-LINK Twin Contact with R-3.
U_0x001D49: A prototype all-purpose decisive-strike <Personal Trooper> of the <SRX Project>, formed from R-1, R-2 Powered, and R-3 Powered. Officially "SUPER ROBOT X-TYPE." Its concept: "a humanoid weapon combining the traits of a special humanoid mobile weapon (<S.Unit>/Super Robot) and a <Personal Trooper>, able to change the course of battle as one unit or three separate machines." The <SRX Project> positioned it as a combiner in which three 20-meter-class <Personal Trooper>s unite into a 50-meter-class <S.Unit>. Separating or combining to suit the situation gives flexibility: against many weaker foes, or when coordinating with other <Personal Trooper>s, the units act separately; against a few powerful foes they combine to concentrate the R Series' strength. Its attack power is superb, but the <Tronium> Engine is hard to regulate, and in combat a Telekinetic Field must stay deployed via the <T-LINK System> to hold the combined state, straining its user severely; this limits combinations per sortie and combat time.
